metadata.name: jurisdiction_advisor
metadata.description: Peer Open Agentic Web network that enriches contract audits with regional consumer, labor, and tenant statutory protections (US, EU, UK, TR).

tools.name: jurisdiction_router

function.description: Front agent that matches the detected document type and region to applicable statutory safeguards.

tools.instructions: Inspect the contract language and document type, then return concise, non-legal-advice statutory checklists for the relevant jurisdiction (US FTC/State, EU GDPR/Consumer Rights Directive, UK Consumer Rights Act, or Turkey TBK/KVKK).

tools.name: regional_statute_agent

function.description: Supplies grounded statutory reminders for unfair terms, non-competes, and rent/fee caps.

tools.instructions: Return 3 concise statutory rights reminders relevant to the document type and jurisdiction.
